description: Devonte and Qieana Mitchell are embracing their new reality after a car accident left her battling severe brain damage. The pair met in church and were married in 2022. Qieana had just had a baby boy, and they were settling into life. Their world changed in 2024 when Qieana's accident left her with several devastating injuries. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more. To donate to their GoFundMe, visit https://www.gofundme.com/f/qieana-mitchells-recovery
title: Texas Woman Battling Traumatic Brain Injury After Roll-Over Accident
